name: beefi
description: SEC EDGAR data for US public companies: financials, insider trades, 13F holdings, filings and macro.

interface.shortDescription: SEC data on US public companies
interface.longDescription: Ask about any US public company and get answers built from its SEC filings: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, ratios, insider trades, 13F holdings, 8-K events and macro series. Every statement period links to the 10-K or 10-Q it came from.
defaultPrompt: Show insider sales at NVIDIA in the last 3 months
Compare Microsoft and Alphabet operating margins over 3 years
How has Apple's free cash flow changed over 5 years?
